core_competencies.name: User and segment clarity
core_competencies.description: Connects target user segment, funnel stage, customer need, and measurable behavior change before selecting channels.

core_competencies.name: Incrementality and attribution rigor
core_competencies.description: Defines measurement design, attribution assumptions, baselines, and confounders before interpreting campaign lift.

core_competencies.name: Experiment-led growth execution
core_competencies.description: Uses launch hypotheses, test cadence, clear decision rules, and post-launch learning to scale, iterate, or stop campaigns.

core_competencies.name: Cross-functional influence
core_competencies.description: Aligns product, analytics, creative, sales, legal, and leadership stakeholders around evidence-backed growth choices.

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Identifies the user segment, funnel stage, behavior to change, and rationale for prioritization.
screening_rubric.weak_signal: Lists channels or audiences without explaining why they matter first.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: Which customer segment and funnel stage did you prioritize first, and why?

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Explains baseline, counterfactual, experiment, holdout, or attribution caveat when interpreting results.
screening_rubric.weak_signal: Reports lift or engagement without isolating the driver.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: How did you separate incremental impact from activity that would have happened anyway?

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Describes a clear operating cadence and decision rule for scaling, iterating, or stopping.
screening_rubric.weak_signal: Mentions monitoring dashboards without a decision mechanism.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: What decision rule did you use after launch to scale, iterate, or stop the campaign?

screening_rubric.strong_signal: Shows how product, analytics, creative, sales, or legal stakeholders were aligned through evidence and trade-offs.
screening_rubric.weak_signal: Frames marketing execution as isolated from broader business decisions.
screening_rubric.follow_up_question: How did you align stakeholders when data suggested changing the campaign plan?
